query_lines: -- Alert: Credit Card Fraud Model Degradation
-- Triggers when the F1-score for the fraud class computed exclusively over
-- labeled transactions drops more than 5 percentage points below the baseline
-- F1-score. This query works directly on the inference table filtering out null labels,
-- which avoids the artificially low F1 caused by delayed feedback. Evaluates the most
-- recent week that has at least 100 labeled transactions and 10 confirmed fraud cases.
-- Only considers the current champion model version.
SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = 1 AND is_fraud = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tp,
SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = 1 AND is_fraud = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fp,
SUM(CASE WHEN prediction = 0 AND is_fraud = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fn
ROUND(2.0 * f.tp / NULLIF(2 * f.tp + f.fp + f.fn, 0), 4) AS f1_confirmed,
ROUND(2.0 * f.tp / NULLIF(2 * f.tp + f.fp + f.fn, 0) - b.f1_baseline, 4) AS f1_delta
